highlight.title: Great Leaders Empower Strategic Decision-Making Across the Organization
highlight.summary: The individualistic traits that once fueled leaders' early success often become liabilities in complex environments that call for scale. Leaders must transition from solving problems through personal effort to empowering strategic thinking across their entire organization to avoid becoming bottlenecks to growth.

resources.title: When Authentic Leadership Backfires
resources.why_now: New research challenges the authenticity orthodoxy, showing that impression management and adapting to situational demands can actually make leaders appear more authentic and trustworthy than rigid 'be yourself' approaches.

resources.title: The 4 Stages of Psychological Safety: A 2025 Guide to Thriving Teams
resources.why_now: Psychological safety research has evolved beyond basic concepts into practical frameworks that help leaders systematically build environments where teams can challenge the status quo and drive innovation.

resources.title: Research: What Leaders Do to Create Psychological Safety
resources.why_now: Recent data reveals leaders performing above the 75th percentile in just three specific behaviors can move psychological safety to the 53rd percentile, providing concrete, actionable steps rather than abstract principles.

resources.title: Leadership Styles and Strategic Decision-Making
resources.why_now: This comprehensive 2025 research integrates leadership theory with behavioral science to examine how different leadership styles shape information processing, risk preferences, and strategic choices under uncertainty.

claude_take: The leadership landscape in 2025 is marked by a fascinating tension between authenticity and effectiveness, with emerging research challenging long-held assumptions about 'being yourself' at work. The real shift isn't just toward vulnerability or empowerment alone, but toward leaders who can dynamically adapt their approach while systematically building psychological safety through specific, measurable behaviors.
